parties: Shradha Realty Limited (Acquirer via step-down subsidiary Raghukul Shradha Realty LLP)
headline: Shradha Realty acquires property through step-down subsidiary via two sale deeds
sum: Shradha Realty's step-down subsidiary Raghukul Shradha Realty LLP executed two sale deeds for property acquisition. The company disclosed this as a general update to the NSE.
implication: Step-down subsidiary acquisitions require careful structuring under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) and SEBI Listing Regulations disclosure norms; verify whether all corporate governance gates (board approval, shareholder consent where material) and title diligence have been satisfied pre-closing.
detail: Shradha Realty Limited disclosed to the National Stock Exchange (NSE) the execution of two sale deeds by its step-down subsidiary, Raghukul Shradha Realty LLP, for the acquisition of property. The filing does not disclose the specific property location, consideration amount, or strategic rationale. This disclosure appears to be routine corporate communication under NSE listing requirements.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 30
framework.note: Central requirement for listed companies to make timely and material disclosures to stock exchanges; property acquisitions by subsidiaries may trigger disclosure thresholds depending on value.
Related party transaction approval requirements if Raghukul Shradha Realty LLP is related to Shradha Realty or its promoter; verify arm's-length valuation.
Board approval requirement for acquisition of immovable property; check whether board resolution was passed pre-execution.
Governs execution, registration and title transfer of sale deeds; verify stamp duty compliance and registration with sub-registrar.
Mandatory registration of sale deeds with local registrar; confirm both deeds were registered to perfect title.

framework.ref: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, Section 29A (if applicable)
framework.note: If Shradha Realty or its subsidiaries have any insolvency backdrop, acquisition restrictions apply to promoter-related parties.
If acquired property is for real estate development or sale, project registration and buyer protection rules apply.

conditions: Execution of two separate sale deeds (mechanics suggest staged or multi-parcel acquisition)
Title transfer and registration with local authorities
approvals: Likely board approval for material acquisitions
structure.novel: Step-down subsidiary structure used for acquisition; specific legal or tax rationale not disclosed.

triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure of material events to exchange; property acquisition trigger depends on consideration and materiality threshold.
Board approval and related-party check required pre-closing.

triggers.law: Transfer of Property Act & Registration Act
triggers.note: Execution and registration of deeds must comply with state land laws.
